programme.desc: 'S5/E12'. Mal Kamper wilde kamp en stap naby die Cederberge. In Turkye stap ons in 'n vallei en besoek Uchisar kasteel. Ons kamp in 'n bus, 4x4 en quad buite Stanford.

programme.title: Dikker As Water
programme.desc: 'S2/E100'. Alev vier Abdullah se verjaarsdag. Gorkem verneder Pembe deur haar geskenk summier vir haar manikuris te gee. Pembe huil op Fatih se skouer oor die vernedering.

programme.title: Suidooster
programme.desc: 'S12/E122'. Dis die dag n die drama in die kerk, en Frankie en Justin probeer sin maak van wat gebeur het. Lee-Ann glo Nazeem is verantwoordelik vir haar mislukking, terwyl Pieter probeer deurdring tot Emily.

programme.title: Skemergrond
programme.desc: 'S3/E48'. Winnie se jaloesie teenoor Jasmine ontaard in 'n bakleiery. Christine vertel vir Haylee oor Rynard se groot gebaar en raak paniekbevange wanneer dinge te intiem word.

programme.title: Klaskamer 10
programme.desc: 'S10/E70'. Werner behandel graad 12 fisiese wetenskappe konsepte.

programme.title: 1 Spoor Avonture
programme.desc: 'S2/E1'. 1 Spoor Avonture begin by Country Trax buite Amersfoort. Hier kry ons wenke en selfvertroue vir ons groot agterpaaie-sloertoer van noord na suid.

programme.title: Overbergbewoners
programme.desc: 'S1/E9 - Warnick October & Andr & Shelby Pietersen'. In Elim ontmoet ons tradisionele rietdakdekker Warnick October en familie. Ons kuier op Vadersbergplaas waar boomkundiges Andr en Shelby Pietersen 'n selfstandige lewe in die bos bou.

programme.title: Banana Air
programme.desc: 'S1/E11'. Hester se video word verwyder. Sakkie se eks-vrou oorreageer. Barbie konfronteer Hester, en die personeel stem in tot die nuwe rels.

programme.title: Binnelanders
programme.desc: 'S15/E80'. Tertius is huiwerig om Tracy te besoek, en Jess en Petro stel die idee van 'speed dating' aan Thalia voor. Louis en Naomi besef hulle het 'n groot taak op hande.

programme.title: Renboogrant
programme.desc: 'S1/E41 - Onderbrekings'. Renboogrant is gedompel in donkerte. 'n Gebreekte motor, 'n ongenooide gas en 'n skokkende ontdekking veroorsaak vrees en onsekerheid.

programme.title: Suidooster
programme.desc: 'S12/E123'. Justin hou aan om te hoop dat alles slegs 'n nagmerrie was. Nazeem is 'n doring in Bridgette se vlees, terwyl Emily tot uiterstes gedryf word.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Heir to a demon-hunting clan, Ma Xiao Ling teams up with Kuang Tian You, a vampire posing as an immortal detective, to stop shadow attacks and resolve a century-old feud.

programme.title: 3AM The Hospital
programme.desc: A woman in hospital discovers her husband's affair and encounters another victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit?

programme.title: Kungfu Cyborg: Metallic Attraction
programme.desc: An advanced cyborg cop is created as a crime fighter for the villagers in 2046. It can overcome most challenges except for love and battling a rogue cyborg.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The film pays tribute to generations of stuntmen, including current super stars, who designed and delivered some of the most spectacular death-defying kung fu moves on-screen.

programme.title: Gun N' Rose
programme.desc: A Taiwanese gang boss names his adopted son Long Yi as his successor. This provokes Long Er (his biological son) to murder his father. Long Yi must now confront Long Er in a final battle.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: A retired agent's past is exposed when the Green Dragon Gang destroys his antique shop's street. Hunted by a mysterious organization, he is drawn into a showdown.

programme.title: Century of the Dragon
programme.desc: An undercover detective is assigned to take down a triad boss. However, he instead develops a friendship with the crime lord and is soon torn between duty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Back on the Society
programme.desc: A retired triad leader is drawn back into the underworld after rescuing an ally. When his daughter is kidnapped, he launches a war against a ruthless crime syndicate.

programme.title: The Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Adapted from real events, the story is about a police special team fighting underground criminal organizations with wit and bravery, finally wiping out the enemy.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A destitute young man arrives in the city and begins working with his late father's friend, who manages a workshop and is a retired kung fu artist.

programme.title: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: Constable Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yu Tong. Unbeknownst to Zhan, Bai is a girl subtly vying for his heart amidst their escalating conflicts.

programme.title: The New Option
programme.desc: An elite cop fulfils his dream to join the Special Duty Unit. Now, he faces rigorous training and the challenge of stopping a daring heist by a gang of dangerous criminals.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new-one-armed hero - a man who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend murdered by the gang.

programme.title: Bullets Over Summer
programme.desc: Two unorthodox and reckless detectives who use a demented granny's apartment as a stakeout location develop romantic relationships with her neighbours.

programme.title: The Hidden Enforcers
programme.desc: A retired police officer trains four assassins to punish wrongdoers who escape conviction. However, his good intentions turn sour when the assassins kill the cops.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Ouyang Feng captures Huang Rong to force Guo Jing into dictating the Jiu Yin manual for her release. Will Guo Jing give in to the threat? Based on Jin Yong's epic Condor Trilogy novels.

programme.title: Eye for an Eye 2
programme.desc: Blind blade master Cheng Xia Zi saves massacre survivor Zhang Xiao Yu and takes her in. As he trains her, she waits for the chance to avenge her family.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD.

programme.title: Tiger Cage
programme.desc: A team of police officers uncover their seniors' involvement in an illegal plot after a drug operation raid. They vow to bring them to justice and root out corruption.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying teacher instructs his final student to check on the activities of five former pupils, each of whom he taught a unique and special style of kung-fu to.

programme.title: The Postman Fights Back
programme.desc: When postman Ma and three other mismatched allies deliver a secret cargo to the rebel leader, Ma finds himself on a patriotic quest to save the country and himself.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man is forced to leave home and work to support his family by teaching martial arts skills for self-defense.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung.

programme.title: Clean My Name, Mr Coroner
programme.desc: An undercover cop framed for murder is forced to take a coroner hostage so as to prove his innocence in the murder of his partner.

programme.title: Kung Fu Monster
programme.desc: The Bruneian Empire in the Ming Dynasty offers a monster as a gift. Despite its gentle nature, the Guard Ocean releases the monster, sparking a frantic hunt for the royal bounty.

programme.title: Wild Search
programme.desc: In a gun trafficking raid, a police officer finds the little girl who witnessed her mother's murder by the ruthless gunrunners, and must protect her from being killed.

programme.title: 3AM The Campus
programme.desc: A school girl joins a horror video project filmed in an old building near her campus to take revenge on a bullying gang, even at the expense of sacrificing the innocents...

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: The lead character is out to defeat a mass martial arts murderer with the help of his fellow brave archers.

programme.title: The Iron Fisted Monk
programme.desc: After learning kung fu from Shaolin, Husker teams up with the Iron Fisted Monk to fight against the Manchus who have killed villagers and raped women.

programme.title: Motorway
programme.desc: On the streets of Hong Kong, an arrogant rookie cop and his veteran partner confront a legendary getaway driver, using their cars as weapons in a high-stakes showdown.

programme.title: Widow Warriors
programme.desc: When the men in a triad family are betrayed and gunned down by a rival gang, their wives decide to take revenge for the death of their husbands.

programme.title: Naked Soldier
programme.desc: After killing her family, Madame Rose kidnaps and raises Phoenix to be an assassin. When Phoenix sets out to kill an Interpol agent, she makes a startling discovery.

programme.title: The Most Wanted
programme.desc: A botched police raid leads to the betrayal of an undercover cop. As he is put on the most wanted list by both police and the triad, can he prove his innocence?
